name: Reasoning with Multi-Tool Timeline
description: Demonstrates a realistic scenario with reasoning summaries interleaved between multiple tool calls (read_file and edit_file) and accumulating usage deltas. This tests UI timeline rendering with mixed event types and progressive cost/token tracking.
